questions.question: According to this chapter, why did Yahweh rest on the seventh day?
choices: Because he made heaven and earth in six days and rested the seventh
Because the people needed a break

questions.question: How did the people react when they saw the thunder, lightning, and smoking mountain?
choices: They trembled and stayed at a distance

questions.question: Which of these is one of the commandments listed in this chapter?
choices: "You shall not lie to your parents"
